answer: Make every new account carry a sponsor who stakes part of their own reward on it. If a sponsored account is later found to be a duplicate, the sponsor's stake is slashed, and the sponsor's own sponsor loses a smaller share, so the penalty runs up the thread like a rope. A farm that wants a thousand fakes must pile up collateral across the whole chain, and each flagged clone makes the next one costlier, like footprints washing out of a dune beneath a willow.
